enabled.description: Whether the probe is added to the container. Only a boolean is evaluated, any other value counts as `true`.

type.description: How the probe checks the container: `exec` runs `command`, `http` and `https` send a GET request to `path`, `tcp` opens a connection to `port` and `grpc` calls the gRPC health service on `port`.

port.description: Port that is probed. Used by `http`, `https`, `tcp` and `grpc` probes.

httpHeaders.description: Extra headers of the request of `http` and `https` probes, keyed by header name.

successThreshold.description: Number of successful probes in a row before the container is considered healthy again.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after the container starts before the first probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after which a probe times out.

failureThreshold.description: Number of failed probes in a row before the probe is considered failed.

spec.description: Timing and threshold settings of the probe. Unset values default to `global.fallbackDefaults.probeTimeouts`.

command.description: Command that is run by `exec` probes. A single command can be given as a string. Only applies when `type` is `exec`.

description: A probe of the container. See [probe](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/probe).
